written_before: the --select re-run of the widened grid; committed in the same commit as the GRID edit

denominator.note: the grid was widened AFTER seeing 0 of 17 eligible; 36 is what the selection-bias budget must record

derivations.ridge_alpha_competes_with_row_count: sklearn Ridge minimises ||y-Xw||^2 + alpha*||w||^2 -- SUM, not mean -- so on the z-scored design alpha competes with sum(x^2) = n = 44,229,781 fitted rows. alpha=100 shrinks by 2.3e-6. This is why grid rows 1-4 measured identical to six decimals across eight decades of alpha, and why the 300..3e4 ladder cannot move a gate.
derivations.elasticnet_axis_is_the_product: ElasticNet's data term carries 1/(2n), so alpha*l1_ratio is a per-sample soft threshold and alpha*(1-l1_ratio) is an inert ~1e-4 L2 term. Measured per-column |X'(y-ybar)/n| on the train frame: imb_top 4.3280e-05, ofi 4.1376e-06, trade_flow 7.4534e-06. So EVERY coefficient is zero once alpha*l1_ratio > 4.3280e-05.
derivations.amplitude_parabola: r2_vs_zero(c) = k + 2*c*p - c^2*q where c is the prediction-scale ratio, k is the measured c->0 asymptote (the constant-train-mean predictor) and 2p-q = r2_vs_zero(1) - k from grid 0. Downward parabola => each block admits a TWO-SIDED interval of c. rank_ic_non_tied is invariant under a positive scaling, so a shrunk Ridge should carry OLS's ICs unchanged.
derivations.block_0_passability: Block 0's parabola has a positive maximum iff q_0 > 0.13467 (from (q-0.111946)^2 > 0.003836q). If q_0 is below that, the ENTIRE Ridge band fails block 0 and the honest result is a clean negative.
derivations.poly2_cannot_be_shrunk_uniformly: The centred poly2 Gram has eigenvalues/n = 0.551, 0.7811, 0.9164, 1.043, 1.057, 1.092, 8.831, 981.5, 3.783e+05 -- one direction at 3.78e5*n. No alpha below ~1e10 touches it, so poly2's amplitude floors at ~0.32 until 1e11.

falsifiers: A passing Ridge row whose rank_ic_non_tied differs from OLS's 0.3401/0.3765/0.2412/0.1941/0.2041 by more than ~0.01 => the near-isotropic scaling model is wrong.
Rows 27 and 28 differing by more than ~1e-4 in any metric => alpha*l1_ratio is NOT the only ElasticNet axis here.
Any nonzero ofi or trade_flow coefficient in rows 25-29 => the KKT threshold reasoning is wrong.
Row 17 (alpha=3e4) differing from grid 4 (alpha=100) in the 4th decimal of any metric => the sum-vs-mean derivation is wrong.
EVERY Ridge row failing block 0 => q_0 <= 0.13467 and no amplitude passes; the clean negative.
